issues.description: Tiny extraction requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo ships an empty data/stories directory so make demo and the integration test fail.
The only end-to-end test depends on missing repo data and currently fails in a clean environment.
Documented tiny CPU demo commands are not reproducible from this checkout because extraction cannot regenerate vectors without missing story data.
Validation loads vectors from a manifest but silently builds whatever backend the current config requests, with no check that backend, model, layer count, or d_model match the saved vectors.
Preference steering has the same saved-vector/current-backend compatibility gap and can produce dimension errors or invalid results.
HF residual extraction tokenizes unbounded input without truncation or max_length, making long story files capable of causing excessive memory use or OOM.
The default HF model is loaded from a mutable model name with no revision pin, reducing reproducibility and creating supply-chain drift risk.
Config loading performs no schema validation, so invalid emotions, negative token_start, bad thresholds, and nonsensical counts fail late or produce misleading outputs.
Negative token_start values are accepted and become negative slices, changing the averaging window silently.
pca_components_for_variance accepts threshold 0 but still returns one component, which is surprising for a zero variance-removal target.
A one-emotion config leaves off_diagonal empty and writes NaN summary values instead of reporting an invalid validation setup.
The configured min_reported_emotions value is ignored and fewer than four emotions can still be reported for small configs.
Packaging installs only the emovec package, while the CLI defaults rely on repo-local config.yaml and data files that are not packaged.
